mapper.select: SELECT campaign_id, tenant_id, platform, campaign_name, daily_budget, status, pms_optimization_enabled, pms_optimization_scope, created_at, updated_at FROM ads_campaign WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ads_ad_group (group_id, tenant_id, campaign_id, platform_group_id, name, bid, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{tenantId}, #{campaignId}, #{platformGroupId}, #{name}, #{bid}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ads_ad_group SET name = #{name}, bid = #{bid}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT group_id, tenant_id, campaign_id, platform_group_id, name, bid, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ads_ad_group WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ads_ad_group WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ads_keyword (keyword_id, tenant_id, group_id, keyword_text, match_type, bid, status, impressions, clicks, spend, sales, acos, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{keywordId}, #{tenantId}, #{groupId}, #{keywordText}, #{matchType}, #{bid}, #{status}, #{impressions}, #{clicks}, #{spend}, #{sales}, #{acos}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT keyword_id, tenant_id, group_id, keyword_text, match_type, bid, status, impressions, clicks, spend, sales, acos, created_at, updated_at FROM ads_keyword WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY keyword_text ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ads_keyword WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND keyword_id = #{keywordId}
